column3: The onboarding flag write is best-effort: createFirstCaptain sets the first Captain before owner.set { onboarded } and ignores its failure, and skipStep catches it before navigating
column4: A failed flag write must not show "The Captain could not be created" for a Captain that exists, nor leave an unhandled rejection from void skipStep(n); the live-Captain fallback already counts that home as onboarded
column5: web/src/state/onboarding.test.ts: both writes asserted, and a failing owner.set still navigates and keeps the Captain; removing the writes or restoring the old order fails both tests
